name: matte-toybox-playworld
thesis: A full-bleed matte 3D toy world you inhabit — walk, drive, fly at eye level instead of scrolling — hue and silhouette separating objects, candy grading per zone, UI shrunk to a white sticker layer.
temperature: Candy over cool fog #93a2bf: sky #81BFBC, ink #363a3c, accent #66BDE6, #f3c258 #c25959
type: Physical type: extruded 3D letters in-scene; MSDF in-world copy (UglyDave-Alternates dialogue, REM-Medium nametags)
motion: Mostly linear — 'none' 69x vs inOut1 11x; physics carries the feel. House eases: inOut1 cubic-bezier(.5,0,.1,1), inOut2 (.56,0,0,1).
for: Brief is 'a world exists and you should want to be in it' with a real loop — play, explore, role-play — to justify traversal replacing scroll.
not_for: Pastiche when content needs SEO/a11y/deep-links/conversion (empty-DOM trade); a game-skin with no playable loop; multiplayer as decoration; real content on a walkable sphere — no URLs, no back button.
axis: Traversal agency vs surviving chrome: Bruno's physics car, zero chrome → Messenger in-canvas UI → Kode diorama-menu → Oat watch-and-choose
vocabulary: Full-bleed matte 3D toy world you inhabit, not scroll — walk/drive/tilt; one continuous place (tiny planet: radius ~40 units vs 2-unit character, horizon visibly curves).

Every surface untextured, colored from one tiny nearest-filtered palette atlas; two tones per hue — base + derived shadow (HSV value halved, hue −0.02); separation by hue and silhouette, never lighting.
Specular is a label, not a light: 0.075 on non-up world faces, 0.0 on characters.
Grading wholesale per zone — exponential fog #93a2bf→#9ea7b8 + a 3D LUT — travel reads as a temperature change.
Inked branch: one dark-slate line, never black (#363a3c), post-process edge detect broken up by noise so it reads hand-drawn.

White sticker UI, no chassis — bubbles, cards, discs, arrows; no bar/tray/backdrop. Wayfinding diegetic: quest arrows, NPCs, road paint, a map you hold. Type physical — extruded 3D letters in-scene (MSDF).

name: blackbox-keyline-hud
thesis: No document: a black full-viewport canvas stage where emissive content is the only light, the interface is hairline HUD keylines in tracked micro-caps, and navigation is camera travel.
temperature: Cold void: near-black #0e1215 → blue-green #192a2c edge haze; white .3-alpha chrome
type: NB Architekt: tracked micro-caps 9–15px / 0.1em for all labels + one 110px hairline display cut; nothing mid-size
motion: Camera travel on a waypoint rail, 700ms easeOutCubic into panels; framerate-normalized chase lerps; permanent slow drift; easeOutSine/Cubic
for: Briefs where a live WebGL scene IS the content — immersive showcases, museums, launch experiences; low density, exploration over findability.
not_for: Pastiche when: HUD chrome over a flat page with no live scene beneath; content-dense or must-be-found material; stock three.js+GSAP rebuilds; hardcoded chrome white (must be per-scene tokens).
axis: How much chroma the void allows and what emits: Orano's lone chartreuse pointer → Xbox's five-hue legend → V6/V4's dichroic-neon spectra.
vocabulary: Black canvas stage, no document — emissive content is the only light; materials start vec4(vec3(0.0),1.0) and only add.
Ground near-black #0e1215 warming to cold blue-green #192a2c at the frame edges — inverse vignette: additive corner haze, hue drifting on a noise field; wet and unlit.

Chrome is hairline HUD only: unfilled rects, capsule pills, 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3) rest / .5 hover / .8 focus, width animating 200→330px over 0.8s cubic-bezier(.17,.4,.02,.99); <</>>-steppers, tick rails, [ MOBILE SYNC ] brackets.
NB Architekt micro-caps 9–15px / 0.1em vs one 110px Light display word; nothing mid-size.
DOM chrome composites as light — mix-blend-mode: color-dodge / plus-lighter, normal under 768px.
Bloom at luminosityThreshold 0 composited as pow(bloom,1.8) so blacks never fog; chromatic aberration keyed to scroll delta, clean at rest; one focal object per frame.

name: overscale-grotesk-whiteout
thesis: One grotesk at billboard scale cropped by the viewport, a bimodal scale (display vs ~11px caps), achromatic two-value chrome; photography supplies 100% of the color; sections invert whole grounds.
temperature: Cold neutral #1c1c1c/#fff to warm bone #fcf6f4/#100f0f (ali-ali); always one pair
type: One grotesk sitewide (Neue Montreal variable), 12.5rem/200px lh 1, edge-cropped; heading ramp hollow 3.125→8.75rem
motion: Per-line mask wipes, asymmetric easing — enter 1.5s cubic-bezier(.075,.82,.165,1), exit .6s harder; survives with zero animation library
for: Sites fronting commissioned campaign photography or a photographed physical object — foundries, studios, portfolios — where imagery earns 200px of empty ground.
not_for: With stock photography it reads unstyled, not restrained; in product-is-colour categories (food, fashion, cosmetics, paint); anywhere a mid-scale subhead, second face, or accent hue is needed.
axis: Motion substrate deforming the billboard word, 2018→2024: WebGL displacement → marquee → GSAP scroll → pure CSS transitions (pangram)
vocabulary: Achromatic chrome — one ground, one ink, nothing between — one grotesk at billboard scale (12.5rem/200px, line-height 1) over a full-bleed photograph desaturated to zero chroma: 100% of the color is photographed, not painted.
Display type is cropped by the frame — it breaks where the viewport makes it break; the cut letterform is the composition.
Bimodal scale: display vs ~11px-to-1rem caption register; the heading ramp's middle is never declared (3.125rem jumps straight to 8.75rem).
Chrome exiled to the four corners, hairline-thin — wordmark, nav words, a numeral, a 'Scroll' cue, outlined pagination dots — in currentColor and 1px rules over the image, never filled panels.
Sections invert whole grounds, not dividers: one token pair flips ink and ground; borrowed currentColor follows for free.
Hero set as a specimen string, not a sentence — at 200px the letterforms are the subject.

name: colorfield-poster-grotesk
thesis: Silkscreen-poster logic on scroll: flat saturated colour fields with viewport-scale grotesk in black/white ink, hierarchy from scale and ink discipline alone, and whole-ground hard swaps per section.
temperature: Flat and printed; #ffa441 #16a147 #4596ff #ff6359 fields, pure #000/#fff ink
type: Three voices, no mid-sizes: ultra-black grotesk at viewport scale, serif for all prose, mono 500 uppercase at 12/14px.
motion: Hard ground cut at the seam, never crossfade; chrome re-inks over .2s; sticky scale-scrub squashes the poster (ease:none); Lenis .6
for: Editorial, cultural and archive subjects; brand or exhibition sites with real long-form to carry; clients who own strong flat artwork or photography.
not_for: Poster screens without a reading system say nothing; bracket-mono labels alone = generic 2023 tic; synthetic squiggles = decoration; one shadow/gradient/rounded card collapses the conceit.
axis: Ink chroma: achromatic + one red emblem → near-black/white on colour → second pigment (brown on amber) → 40%-opacity tinted mono
vocabulary: One flat, unmodulated, saturated colour field owns each section edge to edge; the next section arrives in a different colour — a hard swap at the seam, never a crossfade, never a gradient.
Ink disciplined to near-black or white only; hierarchy comes from scale and how much empty field is left around the words.
Headline is grotesk at viewport scale, bleeding the full measure, often SVG outlines (preserveAspectRatio="none") so it squashes to any box.
Deadpan apparatus of uppercase mono micro-type — bracketed labels, counters, index numbers — pinned to corners at exactly 12/14px.
Photography and drawings arrive as sharp-edged rectangles or as mix-blend-mode:multiply ink laid straight onto the colour: no shadow, no rounding, no card.
Optional tooth: 512px noise tile at 0.04 alpha over every ground (Getty) — or none (Frans Hals); nothing else permitted.

name: prop-occluded-grotesk
thesis: One flat single-hue field, an oversized uppercase grotesk headline, and matte-or-glassy 3D props layered with the type in depth — all depth from occlusion, never drop shadows — plus quiet pill/micro chrome.
temperature: Cool pales to hot flats: periwinkle #c9d2e7 / WebGL 0xCAD6EC, vermilion #ff5043, #dbdad9→#fff
type: Oversized uppercase grotesk (Neue Machina) on a hard pixel ladder 30–120px, line-height:100%, irregular word gaps
motion: Two-speed: idle 3s sine.inOut yoyo (±20° yaw/±8° pitch) under a lagging 2s pointer tween, riding a scroll-scrubbed camera walk (2090vh track)
for: Agency/studio statements, single-product launches, brand monuments — one idea fills a viewport and the brief has more 3D budget than copy.
not_for: Neue Machina + chrome plus-blocks lifted whole is 2022–23 period costume; flat props on a flat field without material value-work; 2090vh tracks on pages with copy to read; hidden-h1 depth hacks.
axis: Prop meaning: pure volume (noomo) → gesture/desk objects → literal SKUs (silencio); hue and occlusion direction vary independently.
vocabulary: One flat single-hue field edge to edge — no gradient, photo, card or gutter: periwinkle #c9d2e7 with WebGL clear 0xCAD6EC matched to it; vermilion #ff5043; #dbdad9→#fff wash.
Oversized uppercase grotesk on a hard pixel ladder — Neue Machina 30/54/60/90/100/120px, line-height:100%, broken by irregular word gaps, not even tracking.
3D props layered WITH the type in depth: one glyph passes in front of a block, the next slides behind and blurs — depth from occlusion, never drop shadows.
Prop material supplies the value range the hue refuses, baked not lit: transmission:1/clearcoat:1 glass off an equirect JPEG, matcap PNGs with zero lights.
Whisper chrome: 12px uppercase nav at .02em in a 96px header over blur(15px) tint, 100px-radius pills, 16px/130% paragraph 128px off the bottom.
Two-speed drift: 3s sine.inOut yoyo ±20° yaw/±8° pitch under a 2s pointer tween, on a scroll-scrubbed camera; one idea per viewport.

name: flat-mascot-carnival
thesis: Flat-vector characters at high density own the page — cropped by the viewport — over saturated grounds that hard-swap wholesale per section; chrome whispers in pills, motion bounces, never fades.
temperature: Loud warm childlike: marigold #ffd372, sky #88c1f8, bubblegum #f6b1cf on cream #fef7e6
type: One grotesk (Neue Montreal, 3 weights); UI clamp(15px,1.31vw,25px) vs display clamp(80px,23.2vw,446px) — ~18:1 scale
motion: Elastic-only: 27 elastic eases in 11 tunings, zero back/bounce/fades; hovers squash 1.05 then settle 0.96 in 300ms; scrubs ease:"none"
for: Playful consumer brands with bespoke character art — beverage/snack e-com, mascot-led products, sites where a detour delights rather than blocks a task.
not_for: Without a real illustrator — stock or generated flat-vector collapses into 2019 corporate-Alegria; on text-heavy layouts (copy stays off color fields); on task-completion flows like checkout.
axis: Where the carnival is authored, how ground is addressed: data-attr/token CSS repaints + vector engines → one field + physics → raster plates.
vocabulary: Flat-vector characters own the page — noodle-limbed, dot-eyed, unoutlined fills, hairline black only for faces/hair/confetti — sized 16–60vw (130vw on phones), cropped by the frame: a parade pushing past the window.
Ground hard-swaps wholesale per state — color IS the navigation: marigold #ffd372 / sky #88c1f8 / bubblegum #f6b1cf / green #acd084 on cream #fef7e6, ink #0e0e0e.
Literally flat — zero gradients, blend modes, or box-shadows; only depth: one solid offset under the CTA, which presses into its own shadow.
Chrome whispers: white pills at radius 2em and 100%, one grotesk (Neue Montreal), ~18:1 type scale.
Motion bounces, never fades — elastic.out in many tunings (letter pops, confetti settles, hero drop); zero back/bounce; scrubs ease:"none".
A realistic object sits in the flat world only as a sprite (the HDR-lit can), never a background; running text quarantined to cream.

name: flavor-swap-colorfield
thesis: The palette IS the navigation: one flat unmodulated color field bound to the current SKU by data attributes, so switching repaints ground and ink together; one focal object on the field, chrome tiny.
temperature: Candy, warm-biased: mint #8bd3b9, salmon #f7987c, marigold #ffb700, magenta #e34f7f
type: One viewport-scale word drawn through the object: Sailec Regular white, 9.9vw/13.125vw, line-height:1, no kicker
motion: Swap repaints all slots in one beat: 1s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1) + RGBA-lerped canvas clear, restart-from-cur; 2-phase quint nav bar
for: Multi-SKU/flavor product lines with a small hand-picked palette set and budget for one commissioned hero object per SKU — beverages, produce, records.
not_for: Without commissioned per-SKU objects — stock 3D/flat vector collapses it to startup-blob; past a small hand-picked theme set (generated palettes = arbitrary rainbow); multilingual single-script face.
axis: How many palettes and who authors them: 4-10 hand-picked themes buy a commissioned object each; jams' 91 CMS pairs degrade to photos+blend-mode
vocabulary: One flat, unmodulated color field per SKU carries the screen — no gradient, no noise, no photography; the ground IS the brand while that flavor is selected (10 named [data-th] themes).
A single commissioned focal object at billboard scale, colorless or hue-locked so it survives every repaint — faceted low-poly fruit as alpha-PNG on a baked contact shadow.
One display word drawn through the object at viewport scale: Sailec Regular, white, 9.9vw/13.125vw, line-height 1, no kicker.
Switching SKU repaints ground, panel, button, ink and shadow in one gesture — the palette is the navigation model, no other transition.
Chrome pinned tiny to the four edges: logotype, hamburger, language rail, low product row whose underline is an autoplay countdown track.
Shadows tinted to each theme's own darkness at constant .15 alpha; interiors invert to #fafafa, hue surviving as a band, card or display ink.

name: gilded-monument-walkthrough
thesis: A warm monochrome luxury 3D world — plaster arches, ochre salons, gilded skies — traversed by a chaptered camera; large display serif set into the scene, hairline chrome in one gold/sand tint.
temperature: Warm: apricot-over-sandstone, ember-red interiors; chrome #f6cea0 on rgba(37,37,37,.1)
type: Flared high-contrast display serif at hero scale, capped min(20vh), over one line of small sans; no scrim, tracking 0
motion: Chaptered camera: travel, hard stop where the UI speaks, travel; free look at stops recentres at min(|playSpeed|,1); seams hidden in 2s fog
for: Heritage, museum, maison and single-hero-product stories — anywhere the object or place is the argument and you can afford real 3D art direction.
not_for: Needs an authored world: over stock or generic renders the display serif reads as perfume ad and the family collapses into beige emptiness. No ENTER gate or auto-advance without narration worth it.
axis: How much camera the viewer gets, chrome growing with it — scroll-playhead (bare) → clicked chapter graph (nav) → free flight (HUD)
vocabulary: One full-bleed photoreal render of a warm monochrome world — plaster arches, ochre salons, gilded sky — no header, no panel, no scrim, no dark mode; the UI has no colour of its own.
Type sits in the scene, not a layout: flared high-contrast display serif at hero scale, capped min(20vh), over one line of small sans microcopy.
Chrome is ornament: hairline circles and conic-masked arcs (1.1px retina, 1.5px at 1x) in one tint sampled from the imagery (#f6cea0), parked in the corners, one filled accent.
Ordinal chapter counting does the wayfinding — a filigree annulus carrying the numeral, spinning only while active.
Scroll is a playhead: chapter stops in a remap table with dwell gaps — the camera parks, the interface speaks; seams hidden in 2s neutral-grey fog.
Gated entry, ambient audio bed with a mute — a place you enter, not a page. One ease everywhere: cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1).

name: keyart-dossier-mono
thesis: Full-bleed commissioned media annotated by a filing apparatus in mono/tracked caps — bracketed indices, sigla, hairline rules, terminal boots — reads as classified records or a broadcast monitor.
temperature: Achromatic ink chrome; warmth from imagery. #000/#fff, #080808, hsla(39,67%,94%,.6)
type: Tight-not-tracked mono captions (.8–1.1rem, -.02em, slashed zero) vs heavy grotesque scaling to -.095em at 50.4rem
motion: Instrumentation, not flourish: char decode-in w/ lagging glitch tail, index squares blink hard square wave, irregular 150–400ms boot ticker
for: Campaign/key-art sites over commissioned, graded media you control — game/film/entertainment launches, studio reels — where UI should read as annotation.
not_for: Over media you didn't commission/grade — stock/generative fill gives the crosshairs nothing to survey. Borrowed diegesis; mono past caption size or letter-spaced; boot replayed to returning users.
axis: Legibility over media: theme-token swap (kpr) / mix-blend difference (inkfish) / one ink on graded-dark (dark) / corner-pin + veil (MoH)
vocabulary: - Full-bleed commissioned media — painted key art, graded stills, campaign footage — carries all color and emotion; interface sits on it as annotation, never beside it.
- Filing apparatus in small uppercase caps: bracketed indices/sigla ([01], 01K/02P/03R, DOSSIER 02), two-line captions, hairline survey rules, corner ticks, a persistent inset frame.
- Mono tight, not tracked: -.02em, slashed zero, caption-real .8–1.1rem; airy only because a monospace's fitting is wide.
- Display pole: heavy grotesque set enormous, tightening as it grows (-.02em body → -.095em at 50.4rem).
- One registration glyph, never an underline: a .5rem filled square (outlined twin inactive), tick-runs to an arrow, a bracket reticle.
- Chrome achromatic/ink-only; warmth from inside the imagery. Motion as instrumentation: char decode-in with lagging glitch tail, squares blink a hard square wave, black-on-white terminal boot.

name: scrubbed-product-cinema
thesis: One hero product as cinema: a full-bleed stage whose camera is scrubbed by scroll (sticky canvas, prerendered video, chaptered stops), one sparse claim per viewport floating over the image.
temperature: Cold achromatic near-black; #0071e3 pill, #2997ff hover, #111 escapes, #fff flips
type: Huge tight-tracked grotesk claims (150px/.66667 leading, -.015em, desktop-only) over mono micro-caps spec register
motion: Scroll = playhead; chaptered, half the runway frozen hold; image lerps ease .2 (port to damp()), copy raw ease 1; ±40px counter-drift
for: Exactly one object worth this much attention, and the brief is "make people believe it is beautifully made."
not_for: Achromatic void + system blue on non-Apple products = instant Apple pastiche; underweight sequences stutter and read cheap; content-heavy pages can't hold the void — even Apple escaped to white.
axis: Where the camera is computed — baked JPEGs → scrubbed alpha video → cued prerenders → live three.js; copy chrome varies inversely
vocabulary: One hero object shot as cinema: a full-bleed render/footage stage that holds still while the page scrolls past — a position:sticky frame in a tall runway (41-viewport column or 150vh chapters), every copy block over it background-color:transparent.
Exactly one claim per viewport — a two-word headline, a spec line — floating in front of the render, bare or on a smoked translucent panel, cropping the product, not clearing it.
Subject lit, not placed: same value as the ground, only specular rim and reflection — carved out of the void.
Huge tight-tracked grotesk claims; small letterspaced mono/micro-caps for specs and chapter ticks; ground near-total darkness or one graded field.
Chroma rationed to affordances — one saturated pill, one accent — so color reads 'clickable.'
Motion chaptered, not continuous: the sequence advances, then stops dead and holds a pose while copy plays over it.

name: void-specimen-stage
thesis: One sculptural centerpiece in a single-hue near-black void, reframed per section instead of relaid; corner micro-chrome, a two-island type scale, accents only on controls, drag/drift motion.
temperature: Voids: #121212, #2d4034 sage, #030303, indigo (#0d1224 sampled); accent #4456d8 fills.
type: Two islands, no ramp: display serif (Monarch, GT Sectra) at 1.8rem+, sans capped 1.6rem; split by typeface, not size.
motion: Drag, not scroll (221:30); 5:1 elliptical scrubber, 70% commit snap; #121212 veil .666s linear; durations on a sixths ladder (381/505).
for: Campaigns, institutions, monuments, single-artifact launches — one object worth staring at, copy short enough to live in corners.
not_for: No photoreal specimen = just a dark theme; flat vector on #121212 isn't this. Drag-only nav without an ordered journey tanks usability; the display face past a few lines becomes a costume.
axis: What drives the reframe — discrete states+veil, 1-D scrub, scroll+ground flip, overlay dim — and whether a light counter-state exists.
vocabulary: One sculptural specimen owns the viewport in a single-hue near-black void; the only decision is how much to show — reframed per section, never relaid.
Ground: one off-black token in every renderer (CSS body #121212 AND Lottie fills) — not #000, so the render has somewhere to fall.
Chrome is corner micro-furniture: a thin white left column with mark + two text items; no rules, boxes, or rest-state hovers.
Two type islands: eccentric display serif (Monarch) at 1.8rem+, Poppins capped 1.6rem — adjacent rungs, split by typeface not size.
One accent (#4456d8), never ink — only fills on controls: discs, panels, a checkbox tick.
Motion is drag, not scroll: a puck on a 5:1 flattened arc, grab to grabbing; 75% of durations on one 1/6-s ladder.
One photoreal object gets the whole render budget, one hue the whole ground; the object supplies the entire value range — nothing left to decorate.

name: canvas-native-studio
thesis: The page IS a realtime WebGL application: the full-frame canvas does all the voice while a thin, perfectly-synced two-color DOM layer stays out of its way — extravagant rendering, austere graphics.
temperature: Cool blue-violet: electric #1A2FFB on paper-white #F0F1FA, near-black #121416 panel fill
type: One neutral grotesk (Aeonik) everywhere; mono companions (IBM Plex Mono, LusionMono) as opt-ins; headlines undersized
motion: Engineered not choreographed: virtual scroll damped 1−e^(−12·dt), wheel ±200px, overscroll gauge flings to next project; one ease .35,0,0,1
for: Agency flagship, product-launch spectacle, interactive labs — "the-site-is-the-demo" briefs where the rendering is the product and content is sparse.
not_for: Wholesale imitation without perf discipline is a 5MB main-thread slideshow; no custom geometry formats/GPU FFT bloom outside rendering showcases; conversion pages won't be forgiven the usability tax.
axis: Where hue lives: blue-on-paper field (lusion-v3); per-scene hue-worlds under white ink (lusion); diegetic brand accents in white void (GCI)
vocabulary: The page IS a realtime 3D app — no native scroll; the DOM is a thin, perfectly-synced text layer over a WebGL2 canvas.

Extreme restraint: electric blue #1A2FFB on paper-white #F0F1FA, one grotesk (Aeonik) + monos, zero decorative color — all voice from the rendering: refraction, fluid splashing off headlines, matcap-lit models, pointer-reactive physics.
DOM/GL contract: getBoundingClientRect feeds shader uniforms; the canvas renders where the document says — SEO and resize survive. Add keyboard scroll + ARIA yourself; the original shipped neither.
Budget the spectacle: DPR cap 1.5 AND max pixel count 2560x1440, SMAA post, half-float RTs, mobile _ld assets.
Overscroll charges a gauge that flings to the next project; webp+depth-map pairs for pseudo-3D cards; one house ease cubic-bezier(.35,0,0,1).
Confident-playful: understated type over technically outrageous rendering. 'SCROLL TO EXPLORE.'

name: display-serif-hue-flood
thesis: A playful poster-scale display serif IS the layout on a warm ground, colliding with circular ornaments, while whole sections flood to flat candy hues via token swaps; chrome tiny, entrances long.
temperature: Warm candy-flat: bone #f3eee8 ground; floods #ffe699 #f8c1ca #a0c0cd #d73234.
type: Display serif (Voyage) at 9.5–14vw, mixed-case, IS the layout; body a quiet sans (Staff); tiny caps chrome, no tracking on the exemplar.
motion: 1.4–3s Power4.easeOut entrances from +50–90px; exits snap back in 0s; ornaments rock -30°→+30° (1.6s alternate), never spin.
for: Personality-forward portfolios, illustrators, playful brand sites with short cadenced copy authored line-by-line and low content density — one idea per screen.
not_for: Content-deep sites (the 7.48 usability score is this rhythm's bill); arbitrary-length CMS headlines; the display serif at body size; unclamped vw type; scroll hijack; ungated infinite motion.
axis: Flood's authority over the type: serif as watermark ground (2-state flip) → black figure over 8 banded hues → loud figure under 6-theme iris.
vocabulary: Warm bone ground (#f3eee8); mixed-case display serif so large the type IS the layout — rows on negative leading (-.3em) at 9.5–10.6vw, a flat pastel ghost word behind at 40.8vw, aria-hidden.
Circular ornaments collide with the type: a 2px SVG ring drawn on around one word, opaque stamps over letters, a 100vw disc as rising-sun ground — all sized in em off the headline.

Colour by the band, never the component: sections flood to one flat candy hue (#ffe699 #f8c1ca #a0c0cd #d73234) via named ground classes; slabs get 15–20px leading-corner radii, a pill caption straddles the seam.
Chrome tiny: parenthetical captions, uppercase micro-labels, an asterisk as nav; display face lent back for one glyph only.
Motion 1.4–3s Power4.easeOut entrances from +50–90px; marks rock -30°→+30° (1.6s alternate), never spin; exits snap in 0s.
One idea per screen, 14–26rem vertical padding, no cards or shadows.

name: floating-inset-panel
thesis: The scrolling document is a sheet over a persistent stage — an object on a table, not a page — with a barbell type ratio (7:1–21:1) and a two-token ink/ground pair one ancestor switch inverts.
temperature: Achromatic: #000/#FFF, #1a1a1a/#f4f4f4, #0e0e0e/#f1efeb bone; floods #DA382E/#312DFB
type: Ratio barbell: hairline didone / scrubbed weight axis / 96–209px grotesk at 7:1–21:1 over a stepped-px utility base
motion: Decelerate-only, two curves site-wide (easeOutCubic + easeOutQuint); scroll writes --progress, CSS calc() does the rest — not tweens
for: Studio/agency sites, type specimens, brand microsites, annual reports — curated documents that own photography or motion good enough to be a stage.
not_for: Docs, dashboards, commerce need the middle type rungs; stage-pin over a flat gradient is just a slower page; pixel-mosaic censor over stock = privacy blur; don't copy the a11y layer — there isn't one.
axis: How literally the sheet is an object: editorial-new scale(.25) on a visible table → akaru seams-only; locomotive's stage is media
vocabulary: The page is a sheet over a stage it never scrolls with — two persistent layers, not a background image; the CSS-pinned stage holds; the sheet slides up and clips it away. Square corners — the rounded inset was awwwards' capture frame.

Two colour tokens, one ink one ground: one ancestor switch inverts a page, section or header; mix-blend-mode:difference chrome inverts free; chroma only as a theme flood or photography, never a third UI colour.
Barbell type as ratio, not a deleted middle: display voice at 7:1–21:1 (PP Locomotive New hairline didone) over a utility base stepped in fixed px (15/17/19/21).
Spacing in design px at a 1440 reference (/14.4*1vw); motion decelerate-only, two curves site-wide, CSS calc() off a scroll-written --progress.
Detail: registration mark and lab label — 1–2px hairlines, superscript counters, comma-run nav, a thumbnail opening inside a headline word.

name: keyart-slab-stage
thesis: Full-bleed key art as the stage; ultra-heavy viewport-scale type physically negotiating with the subject (eclipsed or split across corners); hard whole-theme value flips; micro-mono corner chrome.
temperature: High-heat, no tints: #000000 #DFDFF2 #5542FF #EDFF66; hape #0f0f0f #6a0000 #ffffff
type: Ultra-fat condensed display ~18vw, lh .8, -.01em, uppercase; micro-caps mono chrome +.02/.04em. Hard tracking polarity.
motion: Scroll/state, not hover: scrubbed video, mask reveals, theme tripwires; type rotates in — rotateX(-40deg) 1.3s power4.out, .1s line stagger.
for: Briefs with commissioned hero art — game launches, film/title promos, character IP — where one subject per section can carry a full-bleed frame.
not_for: Without commissioned art — 18vw type over stock renders is just a big word on an empty field; anywhere calm, institutional, or expensive — the palette is gaming/web3 heat. No mix-blend-mode depth.
axis: Stage-art register and what type does at the subject (eclipsed vs split); what pulls the theme lever: page turn, toggle, scroll tripwire.
vocabulary: Full-bleed stage per section: one commissioned key-art field to all four edges at 100lvh, no container, no margin.
Ultra-fat condensed display at ~18vw, w900, lh .8, -.01em, uppercase, negotiating with the subject — eclipsed by it, or split across corners so the art is the gap between two words.
Micro-caps mono chrome in the corners (1–1.2rem, +.02–.04em) plus capsule pills; the middle stays empty. Tracking polarity: display negative, mono positive.
Value flips whole-theme at the root — ground/ink/inverted-ink/accent rewritten at once; the same pale lavender is ink-on-black one state, the entire ground the next.
High-heat, no tints: #000000/#DFDFF2/#5542FF/#EDFF66; hape grounds #0f0f0f/#6a0000/#ffffff with film grain re-weighted per ground.
Depth is occlusion only — the subject passes in front of the letterforms, zero mix-blend-mode; one geometry draws crops and pills alike.
