name: single-ink-cinema-poster
thesis: Cinema footage unified by flooding it with one saturated ink — duotones, overprints — under poster-scale display type and cinema-print furniture on dark stages; one hue is the art direction.
temperature: One hot ink #ff391e on cool near-mono #f8f8f8 / #0b0b0b / #dddee2 grey ground
type: Poster display: variable grotesk 210px at 1728, line-height .8, -.04em, first glyph optically hung past the 8px margin
motion: Panels hinge 4–15° on named transformOrigin corners, child rotates harder and lags; sticky stages + invisible rails, never pin:true
for: Film/animation studio portfolios, festivals, director reels — heterogeneous cinematic footage that one ink can unify at poster scale
not_for: Breaks with a second accent, multiply over bright busy photos (filter, not print), or keyword red on warm footage; copied crossbar logotype = pastiche; products must clamp() the vw scale
axis: Where the ink comes from and how much screen it owns: fixed hex flooded (Line), fixed but spent once (Siena), re-keyed per film (ÖJS)
vocabulary: One saturated ink is the entire art direction, as printer's overprint: an aria-hidden div filled flat red, mix-blend-mode:multiply over greyscaled footage — cels, documentary photos, live video all arrive on one hue (.acetate, after the gel sheet).
Poster display: variable grotesk, 210px on a 1728 grid, line-height .8, -.04em, first glyph hung past the 8px margin by a per-glyph negative-margin table.
Everything is a rectangle of paper: panels and routes enter rotating 4–15° about a named corner, inner rotating harder and lagging — sheets sheared on a light table.
Cinema-print furniture, working-studio voice: status dots, slash nav, / MICRO / LABELS /, underlined credit tables, a 00/24 fps preloader at headline scale, Roman-numeral year.
Near-monochrome stage — paper-white, near-black, cool grey ground — colour rationed to one hex; a full-bleed takeover of it is an event.

name: slat-reel-strip
thesis: One lateral strip of tall vh-proportioned media slats on an empty ground; the centered slat enlarges and takes color, travel is sideways scrubbing, chroma lives inside the slats, corner chrome quiet.
temperature: Neutral, value-compressed: #141414, warm bone #e7e5df, #191919; chroma lives in the slats
type: Two faces, 2-3 sizes only: compressed display title at 37.5vh; 6-12px uppercase micro-labels tracked 1-2px in corners.
motion: Wipes ±101% per letter/line in overflow:hidden; z-push + color reveal + louver swivel all ride damped scroll velocity — stop, color drains.
for: Portfolios and reels with a small curated set (10-30 items) of strong imagery, where one lateral strip is the whole site.
not_for: Client or content sites needing wayfinding (the no-titles hairline readout cost Usability 7.37); catalogues past ~30 items; weak or stock imagery — the drained shell leaves nothing else to look at.
axis: How much strip is present: 30 GPU planes → 10 draggable DOM columns → one card + ghost mosaic; ground variable (Aristide) vs constant.
vocabulary: One band of tall narrow slats crosses the vertical middle of an empty ground, full-bleed off both edges; upper and lower thirds carry nothing.
Slats proportioned off viewport height, never width — 100×370 in a 1600×1200 space: 8.3vh × 30.8vh, 10vh pitch, 1:3.7 column.
Chroma quarantined in the slats; ground/type/chrome value-compressed: #141414, warm bone #e7e5df, charcoal #191919; at rest slats drain to gray.
One slat privileged: the centered one enlarges, takes color, gains z — that is the entire navigation; no menu, no grid, no second view.
Compressed display face at 37.5vh titles; 6–12px uppercase micro-labels tracked 1–2px in corners at 40–50px margins.
Sideways scrub, no scrollbar; readout is a hairline — 1px ticks, one per project, widening to 16:9 thumbnails on hover.
Wipes in 4 directions inside overflow:hidden, per letter or line; recolors 500ms cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94).

palette: #f0a9bb (SAMPLED, per-slide photo chroma — changes with each case study)

name: webgl-scroll-journey
thesis: The page is a scripted camera path through one cinematic 3D scene — sections are waypoints the camera flies between, with momentum scroll as the scrubber of a weighty, produced film.
temperature: Cold: #050310 base, cyan pair #4cc9f0/#7df9ff, off-white #eef2ff; warm only at blast
type: Three-role: geometric display (Space Grotesk), neutral body, 10px uppercase mono at 0.2-0.34em tracking for all labels.
motion: Everything damps, slerps, breathes — nothing snaps; camera trails scroll (damp λ3.2), smoothstep-window reveals, asymmetric λ0.7/9 climax.
for: Portfolio or launch/announcement fan-outs where the experience IS the product; on a SaaS landing only as the deliberate loud-wildcard variant.
not_for: Conversion/content pages: 10-page runways bounce users, scroll-jacking fights reading, custom cursor breaks touch; violet/cyan-on-navy is the gen-1 slop palette — port the rig, re-skin the world.
axis: The 3D world flown through (each member's own concept) and where display type lives — in-canvas MSDF/GL text vs DOM cockpit overlays.
vocabulary: The page is a camera path, not a document — scrollbar as film scrubber over a ten-viewport voyage; sections are waypoints the camera flies between with visible mass (damp λ3.2, Lenis 1.35).
Diegetic cockpit DOM over the canvas: HUD telemetry rail (ALT/VEL/SEC), slash-coded labels ('01 // ABOUT'), corner-bracketed glass panels, blinking status diamonds.
Hairline geometry: 1px gradient-falloff rules, structure drawn with light strokes on near-black #050310 — never filled boxes.
Glow as state: dim at rest, cyan bloom on anything live; base+bright pair #4cc9f0/#7df9ff says 'lit up'; off-white #eef2ff, never pure white.
Whispered type: 10px uppercase mono at 0.2-0.34em tracking does all labeling; the display face speaks only at headline moments.
Motion is drift, not snap — everything damps, slerps, fades through smoothstep windows; brightness idles at 12-22%, earned by scroll.

palette: #FFFFFF (emissive window slits only — fringe accent, not area-dominant)

name: atmosphere-as-wayfinding
thesis: Place-per-section: each chapter's identity carried entirely by atmosphere and grading of one full-bleed landscape; chrome is a whisper-thin caps constant — the weather is the navigation.
temperature: Monochrome chrome: #fff + navy #2d628c (tints #81a0bb, #d1dde8); warmth is in the grade.
type: Josefin Sans 300 caps display (0.1em h1, 0.32em titles); Century Gothic UI voice — 12px caps nav 0.04em, 1rem/1.6 body.
motion: One scroll-scrubbed float (uChapter) windowed by smoothsteps; terrain lags type via second lerp; world-space summit dissolve, not crossfade.
for: Orgs whose divisions are genuinely different places — holding companies, expeditions, climate/territory stories, resorts; needs real art-direction budget.
not_for: Conversion pages (zero-fallback WebGL = blank page), weak imagery (five mediocre skies read as one stock template), body copy at 0.32em caps tracking, or opacity-.4 nav over uncontrolled imagery.
axis: How atmosphere is manufactured (computed shader grade ↔ photographed footage) and how much reaches the chrome (binary ink ↔ per-place hue).
vocabulary: One fixed WebGL landscape is the whole ground (fixed canvas, z-index:-1); the document scrolls over it — weather sections transparent, interior pages opaque #fff or #2d628c over the same canvas; hero 150vh of landscape.

Chrome is three whispered fragments: five division names, 12px Century Gothic caps at 0.04em, opacity .4 until active; a 2px navy rule under the active one; a bottom-left rail of 4px diamonds beside a 2px bar filling as you read.
Chrome never moves — only its ink flips between two hexes (#fff / #2d628c) on .4s linear, from a data-theme attribute sections declare in markup.
All else is weather: one baked lightmap re-ramped per division — warm vec3(1.,.5,.2) above altitude 40 to indigo vec3(.35,.34,.5) below 20.
Josefin Sans 300 caps display — 5rem/0.1em h1, 3.875rem/0.32em titles, 4px diamond separator — set in the scene; the shader grades the landscape to keep it legible.

name: blend-mode-swiss-poster
thesis: Swiss event posters at viewport scale — giant tight grotesk, hard slabs of saturated color, knockout bars breaking type mid-letterform — incident supplied by a fixed blend-mode WebGL layer.
temperature: Saturated full-strength hues on #f2f2f2/#141414 grounds; #27249c→#177aee cobalt, #0f0 CTA
type: Single neo-grotesque, single weight (Neue Montreal 500); h1 17.5rem/1, h2 15rem/.8; edge-anchored, ink white/near-black
motion: Single-axis rectangle slides: 1.5–1.6s counter-translate wipes on cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); exits fall — translateY(100vh) rotate(±24deg)
for: Loud poster briefs: conferences, festivals, award shows, campaign launches — big real-text type, hard color, one signature GL incident.
not_for: An empty interior with nothing live reads as a failed load; #0f0 plus any second accent is a dev placeholder; blend modes die inside transformed ancestors. Add the reduced-motion guard C2 never had.
axis: GL ownership: C2 keeps one canvas fixed under real DOM text via blend modes only; Webbys registers every element as a glitching GL tile.
vocabulary: One poster per viewport, flush to all four edges — the whole screen is the artboard, middle left empty, type anchored to an edge.
Hard full-bleed slabs of one saturated hue — never a tint — ink only white or near-black.

The incident is a rectangle independent of the text: a black slab ending mid-headline so the next line runs onto raw color, or a knockout panel (mix-blend-mode: lighten, #f2f2f2/#141414) making glyphs windows.
Under it all, one fixed full-viewport WebGL canvas on mix-blend-mode: difference — inverts against every ground (coral, cobalt, flat grey), zero per-page color logic.
Closed palette: one dark, one near-white ground, hues only at full strength — acid green to cobalt to black without scattering.
Three curves total: expo-out (.19,1,.22,1) arrivals, hard-in (1,0,.25,.995) exits, (.22,1,.36,1) for 1.5–1.6s wipes; DOM and WebGL synced on one number.

name: contact-sheet-drift
thesis: One draggable full-canvas field of photo tiles with momentum — no vertical scroll — the wordmark drawn beneath the tiles so identity reads through gutters, chrome achromatic and whispered.
temperature: Achromatic: #fff ground, black ink; all colour lives in the photo tiles, none in chrome
type: Graphik 200/400/500 + Optima LT Std 500; wordmark an in-scene SVG at 64% width under the tiles, read through gutters
motion: Drag-with-lag: pointer delta/64 → one offset; tiles chase k=0.05 + ring delay, logo k=0.1; 0.0015/frame idle wander; d3-ease only, no GSAP
for: Portfolios/catalogues whose inventory is the argument — architecture studios, photographers, product decks, archives. Needs dozens of strong tiles.
not_for: Wayfinding-dependent sites: the work IS the menu (usability 7.68) — pays only for studio portfolios. Sparse content reads as empty tech demo. As-shipped: no keyboard path, no reduced-motion stop.
axis: How far identity is buried in the field — in-scene wordmark under tiles ↔ DOM chrome above; 2-axis drag ↔ 1-axis momentum scroll.
vocabulary: The viewport IS the field: a position:fixed 100vw/100vh WebGL canvas, touch-action:none, a cursor:grab sheet; the document never scrolls; only chrome: a four-item nav capsule.
Tiles at three aspects {square:1, portrait:1.5, landscape:0.8}, columns on a 25%-of-tile-width gutter, each centred on its own ragged height so rows never line up.
Field bleeds past all four edges, stopping only at a rubber-band elastic bound — a soft limit, not a wall.

Wordmark inside the scene one layer beneath the tiles (SVG at 64% of visible width); tiles lag the logo, so the letters in the gutters shear on every drag and keep drifting at rest under a permanent idle wander.
Chrome achromatic: white ground, black ink; colour is entirely the photography's job.
One shader uniform is opacity AND desaturate — filtering drops non-matching tiles to 20% opacity + greyscale in one value; hover buys only a 2% push-in.

name: exploded-blueprint-mono
thesis: Spec-sheet register: 1px white exploded line-art diagrams on near-black with hairline leader lines to tiny mono labels, two-column ledgers, and color withheld except on the component currently named.
temperature: Warm neutrals: near-black #252423 inverts to warm bone #DAD5D0 to annotate; hairlines #93908e
type: Two faces, ~5:1 span: wide DIN grotesk (DINish wdth 125, wt 800, lh .865em) capped 4rem; all else Berkeley Mono .75–.875rem
motion: Cubic, short: out(3)/inOut(3) eases, 250ms reveals, 10ms staggers; labels lead the self-drawing leader lines by 50ms; section-height scroll scrub
for: A single product with real, nameable parts and real measured numbers — hardware teardowns, dev tools/libraries, spec-driven product pages that can file claims as units.
not_for: Services, agencies, apps without real parts — the hairlines become costume and the tell is labels degrading into adjectives. Outside dev-tool audiences the 18-hue chip strip reads as an unthemed color picker; no fake LCD numerals without a live metric.
axis: Is the drawing alive? Living instrument (anime-js: real 3D, scroll-scrubbed explode, lines re-solved per frame) → printed datasheet (opal: fixed vector axonometric + hairline ledgers + buy card)
vocabulary: A product page in the register of a patent drawing or service manual: one warm near-black ground (#252423) that inverts to warm bone #DAD5D0 for the chapters that annotate.

One exploded assembly laid on a diagonal, drawn as hairline contours with no fills; tiny monospace part names parked hard against the page margins, each tethered by a 1px #93908e polyline — horizontal run, one break, diagonal exactly 45° whenever there is room, landing on the part.

Color withheld by default and spent only on the component being named: each accent is an 8-step ramp composited over the ground (alphas 1/.80/.46/.36/.25/.17/.10/.03), so a hue sits at full strength on one label and vanishes into the background on the next.
Density deliberately starved — one object, one sentence, a constellation of annotations; every annotation carries a real measured number with a unit (6.41 KB, Length / 55 cm), never a marketing word.

name: flat-sticker-pop
thesis: Dead-flat sticker-sheet: zero shadows or gradients, saturated single-hue grounds, chunky rounded primitives each dealt one candy hue, one loud reserved action color; a play surface, not a mascot cast.
temperature: Saturated candy: #ff6d38 #7a78ff #c7ff69 #ffc412 over cream #fdf9f0 / near-black #141414
type: OldschoolGrotesk 900 -.04em lh .8 vs Aeonik body +.01em; ~7:1 jump; ratio is the portable part (both faces commercial)
motion: Scroll-scrubbed Rive timelines; svh sections overlap via negative margins; CSS+JS share n-out/n-in-out eases; hover un-rounds pill to 1rem
for: Consumer products that must read as playable — gamified apps, kids/education, community/loyalty programs; "make the boring thing feel like a toy".
not_for: Dies the moment a ninth hue or one gradient arrives. Don't copy the 4K-video layer, hover-only states, or site-wide user-select:none; hand-set tilt belongs to Astrology Club, not Navigate.
axis: Black keyline (licenses clashing hues; life in interaction) vs value-cut, no outline (one hue family; life in 11 hand-set tilts).
vocabulary: Every surface is one flat fill plus a hairline black keyline — zero gradients, shadows, blend modes or backdrop-filters; panels read as die-cut vinyl on a stage.
Closed :root palette of 8 hues + 5 tints: orange #ff6d38, purple #7a78ff, lime #c7ff69, cream #fdf9f0, near-black #141414, yellow #ffc412, green #00a652, blue #478bff.
A panel never picks its color — it receives style="--color:var(--cl-purple)" and consumes var(--color); a tile row is a dealt list of hue tokens.
Lime is reserved: the only fill in nav and CTAs; CTA variants are a strict inversion pair (black/lime ↔ lime/black).
Corners are the interaction: 4.6rem capsule at radius 2.3rem un-rounds to 1rem on hover, .3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) — nothing scales or shadows.
Grounds flip black→orange on a 0.3s scroll class; headline emphasis = a --cl-purple block behind one word, ink flipped black.

name: glacial-slate-telemetry
thesis: One cold blue-grey grade moved in value, never hue, over full-bleed expedition photography; structure as open hairline rules, real data as instruments, one accent only on things you can act on.
temperature: Cold blue-grey slate #466383; one accent per build: #ffb702 amber or #f56905 orange
type: Uppercase by default, .1em tracking, self-hosted grotesque; rem rebased to viewport (html{font-size:.52083vw})
motion: One curve per layer: cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) sole CSS bezier; Expo.easeOut dominant JS ease; duration varies far more than curve.
for: Subjects where conditions are the story — expedition, field research, launch/telemetry, climate, logistics — with real measurements and real photography.
not_for: Strip the photography and hairlines become a dashboard skin; strip real numbers and gauges become decoration. Gesture-per-beat nav on task-bearing UI; military grotesque off-subject reads as costume.
axis: Whether the telemetry describes the photograph (Mammut: inert SVG, native scroll) or controls it (Storm: the gauge is a dial you turn).
vocabulary: Full-bleed cold expedition photography is the entire ground; one blue-grey grade moved in value, never hue — glacial near-white to bruised slate — via split gamma (blue lifted, red dropped), multiplicative grain so blacks stay black.

Structure is rules, never boxes: open hairline frames from 1px white spans — three edges, never four, verticals cut to 80% — uppercase corner labels at .1em tracking, one Black + one Regular as heading + value.
Real measured data as instruments: stroke-dashoffset arc gauges, a rotary dial with dashed target sweep under solid amber fill, hsla(0,0%,100%,.2) rails, a meter parked at -40 °c.
Everything else hard rectangles (border-radius:0); the only circles are gauges.
One saturated hue — #ffb702 amber / #f56905 orange — only on things you can act on, restated as a GLSL constant so scene amber = DOM amber.
Legibility via text-shadow, zero blend modes.

name: hazed-relic-runes
thesis: Mythic stone monuments sunk in volumetric haze, desaturated to near-neutrals; one acid accent spent as light and glyphs; an invented alphabet cross-fades beside Latin; tracked-caps corner chrome.
temperature: Warm olive-khaki/cool grey neutrals on near-black #08080c; ink #f8ffed; accent #ebfc53
type: Wide-thin PP Rader caps at 8.4vw/lh .83 composited inside the render; chrome Space Grotesk 300 tracked .1em.
motion: House easing cubic-bezier(.4,0,.1,1); page changes are 1.2s/1.7s linear dissolves, not cuts; synthetic scroll lerps baked world states.
for: Immersive world-building sites: mythic/cinematic brand chapters, game or film tie-ins, WebGL scroll experiences where the render is the page ground.
not_for: Pastiche without real depth (flat art + CSS blur reads as smudge), on light content pages, with runes in wayfinding/body copy, or without budget for a preloader and a keyboard path.
axis: Exterior fog-space you orbit vs discrete interior rooms you teleport between; accent shifts from motion transient to state marker.
vocabulary: Colossal mythic stone architecture — arched pillar-trees, terraced platforms — sunk in volumetric haze under one blown-out backlight; fog.near pushed negative so even the foreground is part-veiled.
Ground near-black (radial #181a18→#09090c over a #08080c canvas); ink warm off-white #f8ffed; exactly one saturated hue — acid #ebfc53 — spent as light and glyphs, never as a surface.
Display type enormous, uppercase, wide and thin (PP Rader at 8.4vw, line-height .83), composited inside the render so chromatic aberration, bloom and vignette sit on the letterforms.
An invented alphabet (SpaceGrotesk-Toom, keyed 1:1 to A–Z) cross-fades against Latin glyph by glyph — a per-character opacity race, not a rotation trick.
Chrome at the edges: Space Grotesk 300 caps at .1em, opacity ladder 1/.4/.3/.25/.2, hairlines rgba(248,255,237,.1), circular rune buttons; the HUD sits inside the world's own fog.

name: iridescent-plaster-gallery
thesis: Pale warm plaster/marble architecture carries the frame under huge high-contrast serif; two declared colors (cream/charcoal), all saturation in one iridescent token spent only on state and progress.
temperature: Warm: ground #EDC1CB/#F6F3E4, ink #212121, fog #E0CFCF; chroma one #EECFFF→#B5BBFF ramp
type: Two families, three files — Neue Montreal + Saol Display Light; huge serif sized to the frame, colliding with the plate
motion: Expo-dominated, unhurried; frame never still (brownian camera rig); capsule border travels on ease:none constant-speed middles
for: Studios, cultural institutions, exhibitions — anything arguing atmosphere plus one name; needs one genuinely strong plate and a headline worth that size.
not_for: Weak imagery leaves corner-cluster chrome on nothing; a primitives/MatCap plate reads as Blender tutorial; one full-chroma photo shatters the blush set; ramp past ~12 uses kills it; no gated canvas H1.
axis: Manufactured vs captured plate: rendered room bakes type in, ink wears the ramp; photo forces DOM type + scrims, ramp goes to UI.
vocabulary: One pale warm architectural plate — plaster arches and standing water, or a marble gallery hall — owns the frame; the interface is corner clusters over it, not a layout.
Display serif is enormous, sized against the frame, and allowed to collide: letters run behind columns, through doorways, past floating plates.
Base is exactly two declared colors — warm ground (blush #EDC1CB / cream #F6F3E4) and #212121 charcoal ink — enforced as CSS tokens.

All chroma is one pink→violet→blue iridescent ramp rationed to state and progress only (hover, scroll fill, drag); never a page ground, never body copy. No focus rule exists — that gap is the family's built-in a11y bug, not part of the look.
Craft concentrates on one 1.5rem capsule: hover is a geometric event — a border drawing itself, a gradient sheet rotating 605deg — plus a cloned label swap.
Warm fog #E0CFCF desaturates everything else; nothing in the frame is ever perfectly still.

name: old-master-remix
thesis: A full-bleed period oil carries the whole surface; every modern element sits in one graphically pure layer — one quarantined accent, hairline rules, one numeral system — painting and UI never blend.
temperature: Warm olive: parchment #f7f7ee on #292919; pink quarantined to imagery (CANALS: #D14836)
type: Three roles, never traded: bold grotesque (lh .9, -.03em), old-style serif (-.05em), script rationed to ::first-letter
motion: Survey lines drawn on via pathLength=1 (3s, cubic-bezier(.34,.22,.47,.84)); chrome choreographed by root data-attributes, no timeline lib
for: Campaign or seasonal microsites and editorial releases where the anachronism has a reason — the conceit must close (commerce props in a 'Renaissance' edition).
not_for: Pastiche when the joke doesn't close (Old Master + random modern prop), when genAI paint artefacts show, when the script face sets words, or in persistent product UI — Roman numerals alone cost you.
axis: How far the modern layer enters the picture plane: CANALS protects a flat scan, all on top; Renaissance re-renders it 3D and goes inside.
vocabulary: One period oil fills the frame edge to edge, never cropped into collage; the modern world enters only as discrete props or as chrome laid over the picture.
Parchment #f7f7ee on olive-black #292919, every intermediate grey olive-shifted (#dcdcd0 / #909083 / #5c5c4e); the shock-pink lives inside the imagery — not one pink hex in the CSS.
A compass-and-straightedge survey — centre cross, canvas frame, golden-rectangle spirals — at 0.4px rgba(255,255,255,.15), drawn on line by line, never faded in.
Three type roles that never trade jobs: bold grotesque for structure (line-height .9, -.03em), old-style serif for narrative (-.05em), script only as a ::first-letter drop cap.
Upper-Roman numerals generated by CSS counters wherever a number occurs — chapters and prices alike.
Nothing of the interface inherited from the painting except warmth; nothing of the painting except geometry.

name: orrery-chart-vellum
thesis: Navigation drawn as an antique chart: orbital rings, waypoint nodes, year-rails as hairline apparatus over cinematic plates, readable face vs hard-tracked micro-caps — the IA is a diagram you travel.
temperature: Warm bone #f5f1eb / plum-black #2f2425 ink; vermilion #f93c04 rules; dark #122330→#431e2e
type: Two faces, two jobs, zero overlap: Roobert 300 carries every readable size; Rogan quarantined to 9–12px caps at .24em.
motion: Iris from scale3d(12,12,1) at origin 0 0, 1s; easeOutQuint open / easeInOutQuint close; rings 150s linear; scroll-velocity skew ±90°
for: Cinematic world-building — game universes, lore launches, atmospheric brand chapters — with a pre-rendered art budget and nav that can afford to be a diagram.
not_for: Anything with a task behind it — the jury docked usability to 7.36. The atmosphere is bought with studio-grade pre-rendered art (no WebGL) and collapses without it. Never scale vermilion into fills.
axis: What the chart charts + drawn vs computed apparatus: system/drawn SVG rings (star-atlas) vs territory/WebGL map, 49 shader pairs (continent)
vocabulary: Warm bone #f5f1eb page, plum-black #2f2425 ink; dark only as a place you go — a menu overlay of -55deg navy-teal #122330 into aubergine #431e2e under a black vignette, irising in from scale3d(12,12,1) at transform-origin:0 0.
The IA is an orrery: six nav items in vw resolving to four exact radii (24.6/44.5/64.1/84.8vw, two pairs sharing rings); SVG ring art spun 150s linear; the dismiss glyph sits at the origin.
All structure is 1–2px hairline; 6px diamonds at 45° mark everything — hollow inactive, filled active. Vermilion #f93c04 never fills an area: rules, borders, bullets, progress lines only.
Roobert 300 carries every readable size; Rogan quarantined to 9–12px micro-caps at .24em tracking.
Fixed 2px left rail: tiled inline-SVG dots (r=1, #78746D, 6px pitch), vermilion scaleY progress fill, diamond terminals; chapter numerals on a 44px disc inside a 52px ring at 20%, tabular-nums.

name: rounded-frame-diorama
thesis: A rounded screen or scene-object on a soft pastel field; one crafted 3D diorama carries the whole story — the camera moves through it, room-scoped theming retints the quiet chrome, two accents only.
temperature: Warm: bone #f2efea ground, ink #241f21, chartreuse #e9e778 + persimmon #f76c46 accents
type: One variable grotesk, connection axis pinned max on every style ("cnct" 1000), titles tracked -.04em; vw scale >2000px.
motion: Expo-out only (cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)), .5s chrome / .8s copy; 150vh-per-slide sticky deck; heavy 3D in a Worker on OffscreenCanvas.
for: Products whose value is a place or system you'd have to be shown — a clinic, a public-space furniture catalogue, a physical service with rooms and stages.
not_for: Needs one genuinely crafted asset; without it, a stock isometric illustration with pastel labels — a 2021 SaaS page. Transplanted moss/kingfisher content is pastiche; flat cutouts read as clip art.
axis: Is the region a place or a moment — Kriss: rooms w/ coordinates, quads named for architecture; Floema: scroll ranges, quads named for mood.
vocabulary: One warm bone ground (#f2efea) carries everything; the only overlay is shade — dappled leaf-shadow in pure black alpha, multiply, never a tint, so the ground darkens toward its own hue and nothing goes grey.

Colour is delegated: photography and one crafted scene hold all of it; chrome borrows — a named token quad (text/background/background-hover/border/border-hover, 4–6 per theme) re-points per region, so a nav pill reads chartreuse over the fluor section, near-black ink over the light one.
Two saturation notes against a twelve-step neutral ramp (bone→putty→stone→#241f21): chartreuse #e9e778 as a whole panel plus a 12px transition hairline, persimmon #f76c46 at chip size.
One idea per viewport, 150vh scroll per slide; above 2000px the scale re-declares in vw — a big display zooms the design, one scaled object.
The moment the interface picks its own colour, the family is gone.

name: swiss-grid-lab
thesis: The page's own construction is the subject — grid overlays, spec tables, bezier handles and keyframe markers drawn as content on flat ink-and-paper grounds: a design system demonstrating itself.
temperature: Flat ink-on-paper: #F1F1F1/#010101, accent #FAFF00, ramp #B2B2B2→#606060→#2C2C2C
type: 10px chrome + 14px copy vs 86/264px display, one 31px rank, no 16px anywhere; tracking ~0 small, −0.04em at display.
motion: Stock easings only (510 linear, 101 ease-out, zero cubic-bezier); travel via offset-path not transform; delay = held first keyframe stop.
for: Documentation, design systems, brand guidelines, editorial explainers, teaching projects — where the method is the content and the reader agreed to be taught.
not_for: Pastiche when the page documents nothing — apparatus is honest only describing what it decorates. No #FAFF00 off-black, no signature curves, no zoomed fixed artboard.
axis: How optional the apparatus is + whether the drawn grid is actually in force: toggled depiction (grids) vs load-bearing CSS Grid (dropbox).
vocabulary: Layout apparatus drawn as content on a flat ink-and-paper ground — no depth, no gradient, no canvas.
Hero: a visible 8-column overlay — translucent bands rgba(86,86,86,0.1) spanning 960px — behind a 10px `Grid:` toggle with a two-lozenge ON/OFF pill.

Structure drawn, never implied: 0.8px SVG hairlines at three lengths only (960/597/352px); 10px spec-table rows as ornament (`Grid | 12 Columns`, `Margins | 30 px`, `Gutters | 20 px`); curves pinned by 8×8px square markers.
Sibling's drafting kit: grabbable bezier handles, 10px keyframe diamonds rotated 45° in #c5dbff.
Two rule weights — the structural one lighter than the ornamental (0.8px vs 1px).
Sentence and diagram share one ramp: 86px headline steps #F1F1F1→#B2B2B2→#606060→#2C2C2C, matched by the block modules beside it.
Imagery only as measured exhibits; all sizes are design px on a 1024 artboard — steal the ratios.

name: torn-paper-editorial
thesis: The page as physical printed stock: warm paper grounds, torn scanned scraps occluding a giant masthead, serif editorial furniture, and motion that only does what a sheet could — tear, slip, clip.
temperature: Warm off-white stocks: #f3efe3 #fefefe #f4e8e0 (Watson), #CDC6BE (Miranda); never cool
type: One display word at 20–37vw, physically occluded; serif copy with drop caps, footnote numerals, hairline swept rules
motion: State changes tear, slip, or clip a sheet — never crossfade; house 1000ms cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), damping 0.09, clip-path inset wipes
for: Studio, portfolio, or manifesto sites with few short routes, print-grade scanned assets, and an editorial voice — art-book or broadsheet briefs
not_for: No-scroll on long/docs/shop sites; four-multiply duotone on dense grids; per-glyph rig on long headlines; ripped-edge PNGs over stock photos = 2011 Photoshop pastiche — 90% asset quality, 10% code
axis: Where paper lives: geometry+normal maps in three.js, modern print (Watson) → texture overlay + shader tear, 19th-c broadsheet (Miranda)
vocabulary: Warm bone paper ground (#f3efe3 / #f4e8e0), declared once per route as a sheet of stock, never gradient-shaded.
One display word at absurd scale — Watson's masthead 22.3vw, line-height 0.91, every glyph hand-kerned — torn scraps of scanned stock interleaved genuinely in front of some letters, behind others.
Running copy: transitional serif manifesto at ~1.35vw, hairline swept underlines, italic parentheticals, superscript footnote numerals doubling as nav — (1) Partnerships, (2) Capabilities.
Photography arrives pre-printed: grayscale(1) multiplied onto #f4e8e0, ink veil rgba(28,27,32,.1), paper bloom rgba(255,255,255,.25) — duotone by blend mode, never asset editing.

Motion is paper motion: damping 0.09, 1000ms on cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1); clippings wipe in with clip-path:inset(100% 0 0 0); page change = one sheet lifts and clips away, the next slides up from the bottom edge.

name: two-face-splice-editorial
thesis: Gallery-white ground with whisper corner chrome and a display headline splicing two typefaces inside one block — per glyph or per line — imagery as floating cropped fragments, one tiny accent.
temperature: Paper-neutral: #f0f0f0 ground, never pure white, two greys; one accent #fe4249 (cursor)
type: One h1, two faces: hairline display serif vs neutral grotesque, display 16% larger; 13.5:1 over support; vw-root scale
motion: One-way data-shown latch + data-d delay ladders in CSS: 25ms/char, 100/50ms word in/out, 75ms/block; four custom cubic-beziers total
for: Studios, photographers, editorial and cultural clients — where the headline IS the identity and the budget is typographic, not 3D; the library's type-only pole
not_for: Pastiche when: hairline face scaled small; clock/counter chrome with no place or sequence to report; era-default second face (Saol); axis change without cursor coaching
axis: Grain of the splice, glyph to line: coarser grain earns its own size and metrics, louder chrome; accent moves from content to interface
vocabulary: Gallery-white #f0f0f0 ground, never pure white; one enormous headline whose typeface changes inside the block — hairline display serif on some lines or glyphs, plain grotesque on the rest, reading hand-set.
Line grain: 11.277vw Gallery centered vs 9.722vw Everett flush left; per-face height .68em/.75em, margin-bottom .15em/.165em pack mismatched slabs into contact, leaving a ragged notch.
All else whispers: .833vw all-caps support in the notch (13.5:1), corner clock, (03/06) counter, hairline nav on fixed column offsets.
Imagery only as floating cropped fragments, capsule/arch-masked (border-radius >= half the width), bled off-frame — never a card grid.
One column unit --gw:4.16666667vw declared once runs radii, bleeds, nav, cursor; breakpoints change the multiplier.
Two papers, two greys, one accent #fe4249 on the cursor disc and one button fill; root font-size is a vw (1.041vw).

name: acid-scrawl-telemetry
thesis: Acid lime on soot black alternating with sage-bone editorial, broadcast stat cards with giant ordinals and circuit traces, and a neon marker scrawl replacing one word of a three-register headline.
temperature: Acid-hot single accent: lime #D2FF00 on soot #111112/#282c20 <-> sage-bone #efefe5/#f4f4ed
type: Mona Sans Variable (wdth 75 = telemetry, 660/93 display) + Brier swash on one <strong> word, larger than the grotesk
motion: Two grammars: clip-inset chased by an accent bar (half-overlap) and edge-anchored ellipse clips; 4 GSAP defaults, ease:'none' scrubbed
for: Athlete/team/personal sports brands, hype product drops — broadcast-telemetry energy plus an editorial second register and a real hand-made mark.
not_for: Anything needing calm, trust, or expense — the acid palette is hype-only. Reads as pastiche the instant the scrawl isn't a real person's hand, or a generic 3D object fills the hero slot.
axis: Where the hand-made mark comes from (real vs synthesised hand) and how hot the accent runs — stated as prediction; single-member family.
vocabulary: Two grounds, one surface: acid lime #D2FF00 on soot #111112 <-> sage-bone editorial (cream #efefe5, bone #f4f4ed, olive-black #282c20), joined by one full-viewport WebGL contour field — near-invisible hairlines (#363B25 on #282c20), scroll-lerped with body background on the same frame.

Three registers per headline: all-caps Mona Sans Variable (wght 660/wdth 93, line-height 90.6%), Brier swash serif on one <strong> word — larger than the grotesk it interrupts — and a neon marker scrawl: scroll-scrubbed Rive drawing itself.
Numerals as broadcast graphics: giant stats at wdth 75, ordinals auto-wrapped, lime only at P1, zero-padded width-preserving count-ups, a circuit ribbon.
Two reveals: clip-inset chased by an accent bar, or an edge-anchored ellipse — the oval is the masking shape (--radius--large 6.25rem).
Gradients end in transparent lime (--color--lime-zero #d2ff0000), never grey.

name: archival-particle-editorial
thesis: Real artwork thumbnails as the particles of scroll-choreographed data-viz formations — ribbons, rings, timelines — on a white museum field with a bookish serif; violent density alternation as pacing.
temperature: Warm-neutral: white stage, putty #c3b8ac tint, frosted #bababa33; fog keeps warmth.
type: Bradford serif = all narration/headlines; Graphik sans = every label, credit, footnote; tracking always −.01…−.03em.
motion: Scroll-scrubbed, paced in screens not seconds (89.5 total); power2.inOut throughout; hover dims .1s in, 1s out; velocity drift on the ring.
for: Collections, archives, catalogues raisonnés, provenance/citation indexes — hundreds of good images + real per-item records; the argument is the corpus's shape.
not_for: SaaS/consumer products (white field + bookish serif = borrowed gravitas); stock photos (swarm becomes confetti, museum register a costume); real DOM content under 90 screens (scrolljacked document).
axis: Latent (1 member): how literally the formation is a chart — texture (ribbon) → notation (wedges + DOM labels at computed coords).
vocabulary: A white full-height stage that never scrolls — one 89.5-viewport spacer, one fixed layer — all colour arriving as content.
~1500 artwork thumbnails (102-sprite atlas, 128px cells, ~266 KB WebP) swarm into readable formations: a fanned sine ribbon, a polar scatter with 10° wedge gutters, a timeline.

Every thumbnail drained to one archival putty tint (#c3b8ac, 10% mix then 50% overlay) so a Delacroix tiger and a Vigée Le Brun portrait become one population; depth-fog toward white mixed from each particle's own colour.
Copy gets a halo, not a plate: rgba(255,255,255,.8) 60% → transparent 90% ellipse, 120lvh × 70lvh — the field drains, never covered.
Chrome is two objects: a frosted grey panel (blur(2rem) over #bababa33) and a 0.5rem dot stretching to a 3rem pill over 800ms.
Paced in screens: one serif sentence holds four empty viewports before 1500 paintings land in a third of a screen.

name: botanical-wallpaper-mono
thesis: A wallpapered panel inset in a pure-white margin: white paper printed with a tonal tile in the section's ink, forest-green bookmark tabs bleed off the edges, one typewriter cut carries all hierarchy.
temperature: Cool paper white + forest green #215732; base #EEEEEE; shades #F45923/#3B7F83/#FAC8B1
type: Rational TW typewriter cut (Display+Text) for all hierarchy; Sailec geometric sans for body copy + scroll cue.
motion: Five hand-set CSS curves, all decelerating to a dead stop; 0.8s cubic-bezier(.43,.195,.02,1) tab slides; underline wipes scaleX(0)→1.
for: Restaurant/café or artisanal-brand sites wanting a printed, illustrated, wallpapered feel — one brand green, flat cut-out art, scale-only hierarchy.
not_for: Grainy botanicals on sage with coral accents is now the default artisanal-cafe template; without per-object chromatic shading, dithered-band lighting, and the 45px module it reads as stock pastiche.
axis: None measured (singleton). Code-exposed knobs: frame thickness (90/30px), ground ink (pattern and tint are one vec3), per-sprite shade hue.
vocabulary: White-bordered panel: 90px pure white on all four sides (30px mobile), two units of the 45px module that sizes every chrome element.
Ground printed, not filled: white paper + a 256px tonal tile in the section's ink — mix(white, themeColor, tile.r); pattern and tint are one variable.
Flat cut-outs lit by one light, quantised to four dithered bands (0.05/0.125/0.2/0.3), each stippling through its own noise tile at 128 device px — printed halftone, not smooth lambert.
Every object shades to its own hue — apple orange #F45923, leaf teal #3B7F83, hand peach #FAC8B1 — never black.
Chrome one forest green #215732 on white: solid tabs parked off the left/right edges (translateX(∓100%)) slide in like bookmarks; 4px progress bar; 90x90 losange buttons.
Rational TW typewriter cut for everything with hierarchy; Sailec geometric sans for everything that is just reading — a voice face, a neutral face.

name: carved-ice-mono
thesis: An arctic monochrome canvas world you descend into, not a page you scroll — chunky sculpted ice with light glowing from the seams, all UI rendered inside the 3D scene as expedition-HUD telemetry.
temperature: Cold, fog-narrow blue-grey: #B6BAC5/#383E4E, fog #6A6F7D→#E1E6F1, rim accent #83A1C5
type: IBM Plex Mono only, MSDF-rendered in-canvas with glyph-scramble decode reveals; reads as expedition-HUD telemetry.
motion: Virtual scroll: wheel×0.1, friction 0.97, double-lerp .075→.15, 1.4s inOut3 auto-snap, modulo wrap; exp/log framerate-independent damp.
for: Brand monuments, product-universe launches, "we are a world" statements; the maximal-immersion pole of the DOM↔canvas spectrum in a Phase-1 fan-out.
not_for: SEO/a11y/conversion pages (empty-DOM scored 6.4–6.6 on its own card); WebGL2-only with no reduced-motion path must be re-authored; expedition-HUD crypto styling as costume on an unrelated brand.
axis: Singleton; the free axis is fidelity of light-from-within — full spectral-IOR WebGL ice down to CSS glow through gaps — not the palette.
vocabulary: An arctic monochrome world you descend into, not a page you scroll: chunky sculpted ice with light glowing from the seams — light-from-within is the motif (igloo core, ice-embedded specimens, lit pedestals).
Fog-narrow palette: #B6BAC5 / #383E4E; the fog gradient #6A6F7D→#E1E6F1 is what actually reads as the background; one cool rim accent #83A1C5.
All type IBM Plex Mono rendered inside the 3D scene with scramble-decode reveals; UI as expedition HUD — `////// Manifesto`, coordinate readouts, leader-line annotations.
Portfolio items as museum specimens: a Pudgy Penguin frozen in a carved crystal with technical callouts.
Infinite virtual scroll (modulo wrap), camera dives inside the igloo; sound first-class — crossfaded wind + music, rate-limited beeps, visible Sound: Off toggle.
Pure-CSS ASCII loader (content: keyframes); film-look via a no-tone-mapping 3D-LUT grade, not curves.

name: cg-diorama-poster
thesis: A photoreal period CG room explored by camera pan; a flat single-hue poster type layer that refuses to belong to the render, hairline affordances at scene depth, treasure count as the whole HUD.
temperature: Warm — cream plaster, apricot tile, honey wood — under one saturated red #ec3030
type: Huge uppercase display (155px @1920), tracked -0.035em, leaded 0.77; three mixins, no scale: display, caps, body=caps.
motion: Camera pan replaces scroll (twin Catmull-Rom splines); GSAP power3.out/expo.out; affordances resolve fill→2px hairline via one lineWidth.
for: Briefs pairing a fully art-directed 3D interior with a bold campaign identity — exhibition/anniversary microsites, explorable scene + poster-grade type.
not_for: Stock 360 photo under the type collapses into real-estate tour; low-contrast red hairline chrome scored 5.80 accessibility; period props without an earning subject read as hidden-object asset pack.
axis: Predicted (1 member): how far the type acknowledges the render — exemplar at zero (no scrim/blend); a #ed3030 flood ships gated off.
vocabulary: Photoreal period CG interior, lit pale and low-contrast on purpose, explored by camera, not scroll.
One saturated red (#ec3030) does headline, eyebrow, body, lockup and footer alike, laid flat on the render — no scrim, no plate, no text-shadow; the render was baked to lose to the type.
Display 155px at 1920, uppercase, tracked -0.035em, leaded 0.77; body set into the notch beside the last headline line; one root font-size (10/1920*100vw), all rem.
Chrome hairline and unfilled; only the two tappables fill solid white — filled is the affordance. Hint rings drawn in the post pass inherit grain, aberration, lens dirt.
Warm set: cream plaster, apricot tile wallpaper, honey wood, a transistor radio; near-empty corridor flips to hoarder-dense vanity.
The entire HUD is one line — N OF 9 TREASURES. Bake the room, don't light it: two lightmaps per surface, nothing shades under camera motion.

name: constructivist-bone-grid
thesis: Warm bone ground, flat near-black furniture: a constructivist monogram masthead terminated by a full-measure slab, one 1px-ruled utility strip as the chrome, chroma quarantined in matte art plates.
temperature: Warm two-token: bone #E7E4DF / ink #141414; --grey declared but referenced 0 times.
type: One face, two weights (KH Teka 400/500); body font-size:1vw scale-locks the poster; display step: 5.69em / 9.5em.
motion: Masked line reveals; rule-divs scale 0→1; stock new Lenis() smooth scroll; hard-cut page swap under a full-viewport veil on a 700ms hold.
for: Archives, exhibitions, editorial indexes, type foundries — a fixed catalogue of real images that disagree about colour and must read as one collection.
not_for: When the brand owns a colour (swiss-grid-lab's side); one accent in the chrome kills the quarantine. Spelling words with the monogram = 1920s pastiche. Mobile gets a different, simpler design.
axis: PROPOSED, n=1: (a) display work the drawn mark absorbs (AIM: all); (b) quarantine airtightness (AIM: zero hue in chrome).
vocabulary: Warm bone ground (#E7E4DF), every piece of interface furniture one flat near-black (#141414) — two colours, no third, no greys; a --grey declared and referenced zero times.
All chroma quarantined inside matte art plates: each image on its own hand-matched opaque fill (72 selectors, 58 hexes); burnt brick / signal orange / chalky cornflower never leak into the chrome.
Chrome is two objects: one 1px hairline and one solid slab (3.19em) terminating the monogram like a masthead rule; rules are bare divs a timeline can scale from nothing.
Utility strip on four tab stops — gutter, a third, two thirds, right gutter — from nested space-between rows, no explicit coordinates.
Poster-scaled, not responsive: body { font-size:1vw }, everything downstream in em; one spacing atom .97em used 63 times.
Density bottom-loaded: columns hang content off the baseline, upper field empty bone.

name: ink-scrawl-white-cube
thesis: A photoreal white-cube gallery on a rail whose entire graphic voice is one commissioned hand-lettered face used as a system — signage, marginalia, inked rules, even the visitor's form input.
temperature: Warm: bone #f4f1ef/#fff ground, near-black ink #231f20, tan #c1ab8e rationed (5 uses)
type: Hand-lettered face bound to 5 classes + form inputs; Georgia artwork titles; Open Sans body; tracking grows with size.
motion: Two speeds: 0.85s quint.out (weight), 0.35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) (state); text written on via snap:{opacity:1}; 12fps brush wipes.
for: Artist collaborations, museum/exhibition microsites, luxury carte-blanche commissions — anywhere a named individual's hand is the asset being sold.
not_for: On stock content it's pastiche — strip the commissioned artwork and it's an empty room with a novelty font. Check hand-face glyph coverage before inputs; the taught walkthrough cost Usability 7.49.
axis: How much of the hand is baked into the 3D world vs the DOM — and how far past titles it goes (form fields = extreme); rail vs room.
vocabulary: Photoreal white-cube gallery on a rail — matte-white walls, polished grey concrete, hard raking daylight baked into lightmaps — whose whole voice is one commissioned hand-lettered face: 3D concrete signage (DO NOT WALK THE LINE), display type, and what the visitor types into the form.
Ground bone #f4f1ef + pure white; ink warm near-black #231f20 (never #000 as paint); one tan #c1ab8e rationed to five uses.
No hairlines: every rule is one inked-stroke PNG (1920:19), flipped 4 ways and tilted 6.43/-6.43/2.22° with 1/cos θ width correction.
Nothing at exactly 0°: drawn things 10-16°, structural 0.3-0.5°, hybrids 2-3°.
Text is written on at hard binary opacity (snap:{opacity:1}); pages wipe with a 12-frame flipbook of a painted brush stroke.
Marginalia parked in the literal margin at -5.45°/+15.98°; a gamma-corrected low-pass muffles the room as the camera moves into a drawing.

name: split-specimen-cinema
thesis: A hard vertical split of two temperatures — a warm bone paper field holding one product specimen against full-bleed near-black cinema of its raw material — one giant display face bridging the seam.
temperature: Warm bone #f1eee9 vs near-black #0f0b04 ink; one dust-rose #a68676 hairline accent
type: One −90° display word at 90–110px; all else 10–13px micro-caps (Gill Sans +2px, Miller caps +6px) — two-island scale
motion: All expo ease-out; every transition is a CSS filter — blur rack-focus, brightness/contrast film burn — never opacity; open 0.5s, close 1.0s
for: Materials, manufacturing, automotive interiors, leather/textile suppliers — the product is a substance and there is real process footage to spend.
not_for: Without genuinely cinematic footage the 40% band is a stock-video hole; the rotated serif Welcome verbatim is 2018 period costume; micro-caps cannot carry body copy; no autoplay ambient audio.
axis: How much the split is layout vs scroll state, and which side carries the ink; secondary dial: 60/40 ratio (invert flips who quotes whom).
vocabulary: Warm bone paper field (#f1eee9, never white) holding one product specimen — a steering wheel, a dyed hide — over a baked-in shadow, no card or frame, hard against a near-black full-bleed cinema band of the same material being made; the off-centre 60/40 seam is the composition.
The split is a scroll state: one 100vw cinema layer slides +60vw, footage counter-translates −30vw so the shot reframes, not crops.
One giant display serif rotated −90° in white at 90–110px, the only type above 15px; all else 10–13px micro-caps (Gill Sans +2px, Miller caps +6px).
Achromatic chrome — bone, #0f0b04 ink, white; all saturation from the dyed material, one dust-rose #a68676 for hairlines and scroll ticks.
5%-alpha animated film grain over both halves — bone CSS becomes paper.
Transitions are CSS filters — blur(15px) rack-focus, brightness(0) contrast(4) film burn — never opacity; all expo ease-out.

name: sumi-e-paper
thesis: Sumi-e ink-wash atelier on warm paper: one generated ink-wash asset family, a single serif at every scale, and one vermillion accent under hanko-seal discipline, voiced in koans.
temperature: Warm: paper #F2ECDF, ink #211B15, vermillion #A4342C (INDEX variant: cooler stock)
type: One serif everywhere: Cormorant Garamond 300–500, clamp(4rem,15vw,12.5rem) hero→caption; Shippori Mincho vertical rails
motion: Lenis .09 + ScrollTrigger reveals (top 58–88%), 2 pins, scroll-scrubbed video via 0.18/frame currentTime lerp, scroll-stirred petal canvas
for: Brand/atelier/gallery/editorial one-pagers where the brief allows an artisanal register; mood pieces selling atmosphere; warm cousin of vast-quiet.
not_for: Ink-wash Kyoto atelier on an unrelated SaaS reads as costume — steal the discipline, not the kimono. 11 viewports of pacing on a conversion page; its reduced-motion guards are fake — write your own.
axis: Paper temperature: warm flat #F2ECDF vs cooler in-shader paper scan; scroll-scrub cinema vs dissolve-and-drift with ambient sound.
vocabulary: Sumi-e ink-wash atelier on warm paper: paper #F2ECDF, ink #211B15, one vermillion #A4342C under hanko-seal discipline — whitelist: nav mark, kanji numerals 一 二 三, 3px caption rule, hover underlines, rotated hanko blocks; nothing wider than ~4rem, never type at reading size.

One serif does everything: Cormorant Garamond 300–500 from a clamp(4rem,15vw,12.5rem) hero at 0.08em tracking down to captions; Shippori Mincho vertical Japanese rails (春の夢、墨に咲く / 花吹雪) as ornament and wayfinding.
One generated ink-wash family: a painting growing onto the paper in the hero, scroll-scrubbed petal and cat videos, misty watercolor landscapes; giant 10%-opacity 花吹雪 watermark behind ink text.
Animated grain (SVG feTurbulence + grain keyframe) over everything.
Koan-voiced copy — 'Petals fall, the tree does not grieve.' — zero product language; CTAs 'WALK THE GARDEN →', 'BEGIN AGAIN'.

name: warped-serif-noir
thesis: Near-black near-zero-sat stage; a monumental wedge-terminal serif dimmed by opacity so ground reads through; headline sheared into stacked clipped copies along drawn seams; warp only under a gesture.
temperature: Cold noir: #151515 ground, #000 sections, #979797 hairlines; one pale celadon #deebc8.
type: Wedge-terminal display serif at 16vw, opacity .75, vs .6vw all-caps neo-grotesque — 26.7:1 ratio is the whole hierarchy.
motion: Gestural, never idle: filters park at 0 — displacement 0→50 on 180ms hold, 1s in/2s out; SVG turbulence shreds underlines 600ms, RoughEase.
for: Studios, film, fashion, showreel-first portfolios — the client is the work, the imagery is dark, the page can afford a full screen on a wordmark.
not_for: Content sites — a viewport on four words dented Usability (7.50); warp on running copy reads as a broken shader; don't lift the trial-licence Klim/RLT faces or hover-only keyboard-dead interactions.
axis: How far damage travels from wordmark into page: case view (shear off, inverted) → hero (4 shards, drawn seams, filters); provisional.
vocabulary: Near-black stage: #151515 ground, #000 sections, hero 85.8% in #000000–#1a1a1a; one monumental wedge-terminal serif at 16vw dimmed to opacity:.75 — a pale grey plane, not a white shout.

Headline = four stacked clip-path copies along diagonal seams, rows nudged .1–.35em off register; three 1px #979797 hairlines at opacity:.52, unequal (33/80/100%), pinned on the seams — construction, not error.
All else minute: all-caps neo-grotesque at .6vw, secondary copy opacity:.5 — a 26.7:1 ratio is the entire hierarchy, no boxes, no second colour.
One chroma, pale celadon #deebc8: link hover + a 10s rotating sunburst, never a background.
Motion gestural, never idle: imagery liquefies under a rotating displacement map on grab (0→50, 1s in/2s out); underlines shred via SVG turbulence 600ms on hover.
Case views invert: mid-grey ground, black type, greyscale photography, same serif as numeral index.

name: woven-scanline-duotone
thesis: A strict two-hex world where imagery, wordmark and page transition are all rasterized into one vertical-thread loom halftone — glitch-textile material against a formal Roman serif voice.
temperature: Swapping earth pair: wool khaki #a89474 <-> near-black umber #2c2824; no third hue.
type: KTF Metro Roman display (-.064em, 83.333% leading) vs Blueline body (+.08em) — two styles of one superfamily, all-caps
motion: Lenis 1.2s expo; images dissolve by scrubbing blackPoint/whitePoint, never opacity; 20x12 grid of scaleX 0->1 cells wipes page transitions
for: Place/heritage/estate brands with commissioned imagery and a two-colour identity — one shader makes even stock-quality source look commissioned. Desktop-first.
not_for: Never a third hue (every cell is already binary; the weave becomes noise). Never rasterize body copy — display-only. Never below 992px. Borrowed Hutsul motifs read as folk cosplay.
axis: INFERRED (single member): how much of the page the weave owns — all imagery (Son Daven's max) vs one hero texture vs transition-only.
vocabulary: Two hexes carry everything and swap roles: wool khaki #a89474 / near-black umber #2c2824 — dark theme is the same pair permuted; scroll flips sections.
Every image and video runs through one halftone: each loom-grid cell draws a vertical bar whose width encodes tone — dark thickens to cloth, light thins out.
Cells non-square so threads read as woven runs not pixels: 150x50 sheep, 200x150 hero flock, 125x150 prologue — ratio per subject.
Dissolve by re-exposing: scrub blackPoint/whitePoint so threads thin one by one; blackPoint > whitePoint flips polarity.
Grid escapes the canvas — 240 DOM divs on a 20x12 grid each scaleX 0->1 for page transitions; SVG wordmark staircases on an 11-row grid.
Uppercase everywhere, two voices never mixed: KTF Metro Roman -0.064em/83.333% leading headlines, Blueline +0.08em body labels.
The clock picks the plate: hour >= 7 = light hero sequence, else dark.
